default_credentials_unchanged.title: Default Credentials Unchanged
default_credentials_unchanged.description: Indicates whether the NAS management interface or share access still uses factory-default credentials that have not been changed from the manufacturer's defaults.

password_complexity_policy_enforced.title: Password Complexity Policy Enforced
password_complexity_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether the NAS enforces a password complexity policy that prevents weak passwords from being set on administrative or share access accounts.

admin_account_lockout_enabled.title: Admin Account Lockout Enabled
admin_account_lockout_enabled.description: Indicates whether the NAS management interface enforces account lockout or brute-force throttling after a defined number of failed login attempts. Applies to both administrative accounts and management UI login.

guest_access_enabled.title: Guest/Anonymous Access Enabled
guest_access_enabled.description: Indicates whether any network share (SMB, NFS, FTP) is configured to permit guest or anonymous access without requiring credentials.

network_exposure_scope.title: Network Exposure Scope
network_exposure_scope.description: Describes the network scope from which unauthenticated share access is reachable — whether restricted to a specific subnet, the full internal network, or exposed externally.

share_write_permission_granted.title: Write Permission Granted to Unauthenticated Users
share_write_permission_granted.description: Indicates whether unauthenticated or guest sessions are granted write access to one or more shares, enabling data modification or ransomware staging.

volume_encryption_enabled.title: Volume/Disk Encryption Enabled
volume_encryption_enabled.description: Indicates whether storage-layer encryption (e.g., AES-256) is enabled for volumes or shares on the NAS appliance, protecting data at rest and if disks are physically removed.

encryption_scope.title: Encryption Scope
encryption_scope.description: Describes the scope of encryption applied — whether all volumes are encrypted, only some, or none.

backup_encryption_enabled.title: Backup Encryption Enabled
backup_encryption_enabled.description: Whether the backup job is configured to encrypt data during transmission and/or when writing to external media.

backup_destination_type.title: Backup Destination Type
backup_destination_type.description: The type of destination where backup data is written — network, local removable media, or local internal disk.

transport_protocol.title: Backup Transport Protocol
transport_protocol.description: The network protocol used to transmit backup data to the remote destination. Only relevant when backup_destination_type is 'network'.

management_interface_tls_enabled.title: Management Interface TLS Enabled
management_interface_tls_enabled.description: Whether the NAS web/API management interface enforces HTTPS (TLS) rather than plain HTTP for all connections.

management_interface_network_binding.title: Management Interface Network Binding
management_interface_network_binding.description: Which network interfaces the NAS management interface is bound to — all interfaces, only trusted/management interfaces, or loopback only.

certificate_validation_enforced.title: Certificate Validation Enforced
certificate_validation_enforced.description: Whether the management interface enforces valid TLS certificate validation and does not allow bypassing certificate errors.

firmware_version_has_known_cve.title: Firmware Version Has Known CVE
firmware_version_has_known_cve.description: Indicates whether the currently installed firmware version is associated with one or more published CVEs in public vulnerability databases.

days_since_last_firmware_update.title: Days Since Last Firmware Update
days_since_last_firmware_update.description: The number of days elapsed since the firmware or embedded OS was last updated on the NAS appliance.

auto_update_enabled.title: Automatic Firmware Updates Enabled
auto_update_enabled.description: Whether the NAS device is configured to automatically download and install firmware and security updates from the vendor.

broad_write_principals.title: Broad Write-Enabled Principals on Shares
broad_write_principals.description: List of overly broad principals (e.g., Everyone, Domain Users, Authenticated Users) that have been granted write, modify, or full-control permissions on one or more shares or filesystem ACLs.

permission_level_granted.title: Highest Permission Level Granted to Broad Principal
permission_level_granted.description: The highest permission level assigned to any broad/catch-all principal on the share or filesystem ACL.

enabled_protocols.title: Enabled Network Protocols
enabled_protocols.description: List of network protocols currently enabled on the NAS appliance (e.g., SMBv1, SMBv2, SMBv3, NFSv2, NFSv3, NFSv4, FTP, SFTP, Telnet, SSH).

plaintext_management_enabled.title: Plaintext Management Protocol Enabled
plaintext_management_enabled.description: Whether Telnet or other plaintext management protocols are enabled for administrative access to the NAS appliance.

insecure_protocol_enforcement_disabled.title: Insecure Protocol Enforcement Disabled
insecure_protocol_enforcement_disabled.description: Whether the NAS has explicitly disabled minimum protocol version enforcement, allowing clients to negotiate down to legacy/insecure protocol versions.

audit_logging_enabled.title: Audit Logging Enabled
audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether audit logging is enabled on the NAS device, capturing file access, authentication events, administrative changes, and share permission modifications.

log_forwarding_configured.title: Log Forwarding to SIEM Configured
log_forwarding_configured.description: Whether the NAS device is configured to forward logs to a remote SIEM or syslog server, preventing sole reliance on local-only log storage.

logged_event_categories.title: Logged Event Categories
logged_event_categories.description: List of event categories currently enabled for logging (e.g., 'file_access', 'authentication', 'admin_changes', 'share_permission_modifications').

snapshots_enabled.title: Snapshots Enabled
snapshots_enabled.description: Whether automated snapshots are enabled on the NAS volume or share.

snapshot_retention_days.title: Snapshot Retention Period (Days)
snapshot_retention_days.description: Number of days snapshots are retained before deletion; 0 if snapshots are disabled or retention is not configured.

snapshot_stored_on_same_volume.title: Snapshots Stored on Same Volume
snapshot_stored_on_same_volume.description: Whether snapshots are stored on the same volume or disk pool they are protecting, making them vulnerable to the same ransomware or disk failure event.

local_admin_account_count.title: Local Administrator Account Count
local_admin_account_count.description: Total number of local accounts with administrator-level privileges on the NAS device.

service_accounts_with_admin_role.title: Service Accounts Granted Administrator Role
service_accounts_with_admin_role.description: Indicates whether any service accounts used by applications or automated processes have been granted administrator-level privileges on the NAS.

shared_admin_credentials_in_use.title: Shared Administrative Credentials In Use
shared_admin_credentials_in_use.description: Indicates whether multiple personnel or systems share a single administrative account with no individual accountability per admin.

credential_files_encrypted.title: Credential Files Encrypted at Rest
credential_files_encrypted.description: Whether configuration files containing credentials (backup job configs, LDAP bind passwords, replication credentials) are encrypted at rest on the appliance filesystem rather than stored in plaintext.

scripts_contain_hardcoded_credentials.title: Scripts Contain Hardcoded Credentials
scripts_contain_hardcoded_credentials.description: Whether shell scripts, Python scripts, or other automation scripts accessible on the appliance filesystem contain hardcoded usernames, passwords, or tokens in plaintext.

credential_store_type.title: Credential Storage Mechanism
credential_store_type.description: The mechanism used by the appliance to store service credentials such as backup, LDAP bind, and replication passwords.

export_host_specification.title: NFS Export Host Specification
export_host_specification.description: The host/client specification used in the NFS export configuration (e.g., *, 192.168.0.0/16, specific hostname or IP). Wildcards or overly broad CIDR ranges indicate unrestricted access.

export_options_include_no_root_squash.title: NFS Export Allows no_root_squash
export_options_include_no_root_squash.description: Whether the NFS export is configured with the no_root_squash option, which allows remote root users to act as root on the exported filesystem.

mfa_enforced_on_management_ui.title: MFA Enforced on Management UI
mfa_enforced_on_management_ui.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is required for all administrative logins to the NAS management interface.

authentication_methods_enabled.title: Authentication Methods Enabled
authentication_methods_enabled.description: List of authentication methods enabled for management interface login (e.g., 'password', 'totp', 'hardware_token', 'push_notification', 'ldap', 'saml_mfa').

storage_protocol_bound_interfaces.title: Storage Protocol Bound Network Interfaces
storage_protocol_bound_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to which storage protocols (SMB, NFS, iSCSI, AFP, FTP) are bound. Should only contain trusted/internal VLAN interface names.

management_interface_bound_to_all.title: Management Interface Bound to All Adapters
management_interface_bound_to_all.description: Indicates whether the NAS management interface (web UI, SSH, SNMP) is listening on all network interfaces (0.0.0.0 or equivalent) rather than restricted to a trusted management VLAN interface.

untrusted_interface_types_present.title: Untrusted Interface Types Present on Device
untrusted_interface_types_present.description: List of interface classifications present on the NAS device that are considered untrusted, such as 'dmz', 'internet-facing', 'guest', or 'public'.

chassis_intrusion_detection_enabled.title: Chassis Intrusion Detection Enabled
chassis_intrusion_detection_enabled.description: Whether the NAS appliance has hardware or software chassis intrusion detection configured to alert when the enclosure is opened or drives are removed without authorization.

drive_hot_removal_authentication_require.title: Drive Hot-Removal Authentication Required
drive_hot_removal_authentication_require.description: Whether the NAS requires an authentication challenge before allowing hot-removal of drives.

account_lockout_enabled.title: Account Lockout Enabled
account_lockout_enabled.description: Whether the NAS management interface and share authentication enforce account lockout after a configurable number of consecutive failed login attempts.

rate_limiting_enabled.title: Login Rate Limiting Enabled
rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether the NAS enforces rate limiting (e.g., progressive delays or IP-based throttling) on authentication attempts to the management interface and share access endpoints.
